# The appointments Badb made — and who is keeping them

The mistake is reading myths as entertainment. Badb's cycle reads more like a charter — each story assigning a duty the modern world still pays for.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Badb
- **Pantheon:** Celtic
- **Domain of influence:** Battle, Death, Crow
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Commerce & Governance · Society & Spirit · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Defense, Military & Security
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 63 of 463

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Defense, Military & Security — through *The Daughters of Ernmas*

The Lebor Gabála Érenn, Ireland's medieval book of invasions, gives the war-goddesses their pedigree: 'Badb and Macha and Anand, of whom are the Paps of Anu in Luachair, were the three daughters of Ernmas the she-farmer. ' The verse recension sings the same family in another key — 'Badb and Macha, greatness of wealth, Morrígu, springs of craftiness, sources of bitter fighting, were the three daughters of Ernmas' — so that the tradition itself is of two minds: sometimes the Morrígan is the third sister, sometimes the single name for all three.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The screech over the battlefield — the war-goddess whose voice alone kills.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. Industries do not invent their archetypes; they inherit them and call them best practice.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services — through *The Shriek over the Hosts*

When the men of Ireland march under [[medb|Medb]] for the brown bull of Cooley, the Táin marks the nights of the hosting with the sound of the war-goddesses: 'Badb and Bé Néit and Némain shrieked above them that night in Gáirech and Irgáirech, so that a hundred of their warriors fell dead of fright. ' It is the battle's true opening — the killing has begun before a single spear is cast, and its instrument is a voice.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The omen-crow — prophecy of death delivered in the one language that cannot be argued with.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

### Pet Care & Animal Industries — through *The War-Goddess at Mag Tuired*

The Second Battle of Mag Tuired, the war the Túatha Dé Danann fight against the Fomorians, runs on the war-goddess's work from its eve to its aftermath.  On Samain night [[dagda|the Dagda]] met the Morrígan at the ford of the Unius in Connacht, where she stood washing with one foot on either bank; they lay together at the ford, and she pledged herself to the Túatha Dé Danann's cause, promising to bring the hearts of the Fomorian host and the blood of their king Indech.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *The scald-crow — the theonym that is simply the common noun for the hooded crow.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. That is the cycle working: story becomes duty, duty becomes trade.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

Badb's dossier is genealogy, sound, and omen rather than adventure: she is the sister in the list, the voice over the army, the bird on the pillar-stone. The Lebor Gabála fixes her family, the Táin fixes her weapon, and the death-tales fix her posture — and the commentators have spent a century and a half working out where she ends and her sisters begin.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in defense, military & security, astrology, tarot & esoteric services, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/badb/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
